description: Finished matches with official results in Ugandan sport, newest first. Same filters and fields as get_fixtures, plus the score (or a result text for events without a two-team score) and the result source.

competition.description: Competition contains this text, e.g. "Uganda Premier League", "AFCON"

from.description: First date, YYYY-MM-DD (EAT). Fixtures default: today

team.description: Only matches of this team, e.g. "Vipers" or "SC Villa"

to.description: Last date, YYYY-MM-DD (EAT). Results default: today

name: get_results
